$Comment: The feast board, drawn once a day at midnight UTC, one contract per slot. A slot posts only
contracts whose Boards entry names its Difficulty band. Harvest_Feast_Field holds the work out in the
woods and fields (turkeys, wheat); Harvest_Feast_Kitchen holds the cooking brought to the table
(pies, roast); Harvest_Feast_Skill holds the skill jobs this pack adds for a server running MMO Skill
Favor with Martha opens more of the board. The third and fourth slots carry Requires: the second
Field job opens at Friendly, the second Kitchen job at Honored. Everyone sees them posted, and a
player below the rank sees them locked, with the reason. Each band has two contracts, so a band fills
The skill slot is Optional: where nothing carries its band the board shows no gap. Grades names each
band for the badge on its rows: TitleKey is its words, Color the badge's colour. Season makes the board
absent while the feast is off. Its contracts' pay waits here until the player collects it
(Rewards.Claim), so a job left uncollected when the feast ends waits for the board to come back next
year; the board's description asks players to collect before the table's packed away. Order 90 keeps
it behind a server's everyday boards. Where keeps it in the Forgotten Temple: anywhere else it is left
out of every list and opens closed.
